judge.reason: The memo identifies review latency and integration conflicts as the bottleneck and addresses them through scope cuts, WIP caps, small PRs, a merge queue, and protecting the critical path. It refuses to invent a P85 and gives only labeled uncalibrated ranges. It rejects the eight extra agents because they would add review and integration load, keeping any later additions conditional on measured review capacity, disjoint scopes, and a named integrator. It keeps risk-based regression checks rather than halving them, and it never invokes a one-third-timeline cutoff.
